typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		EffDate as date,
		ReconStatus as string,
		ExternalSystem as string,
		SystemRecord as string,
		HoldID as string,
		SourceSystemName as string,
		{Imagine External_Trade_ID} as string,
		{FENICS TicketNo} as string,
		CalypsoId as integer,
		{RV account} as string,
		{FENICS Book} as string,
		DivisionDescription as string,
		DistrictDescription as string,
		SubDistrict1Description as string,
		CompanyAU as string,
		{FENICS Au} as string,
		{Imagine TradeDate} as timestamp,
		{FENICS TradeDate} as timestamp,
		{RV holdingCurrency} as string,
		{FENICS CtrCcy} as string,
		{RV Put Call} as string,
		{FENICS ProductType} as string,
		{FENICS ForwardRate} as decimal(24,8),
		{RV Strike} as decimal(24,8),
		{FENICS StrikeRate} as decimal(24,8),
		{RV Expiry} as timestamp,
		{FENICS ExpiryDate} as timestamp,
		{RV CurrMark} as decimal(24,8),
		{FENICS Calc: PositionValue / CcyAmt} as decimal(38,14),
		{Mark Variance} as decimal(38,14),
		{RV quantity} as decimal(24,8),
		{FENICS CcyAmt} as decimal(24,8),
		{Quantity Variance} as decimal(25,8),
		{FENICS PositionValue (Prior)} as decimal(24,8),
		{RV Mkt Value} as decimal(24,8),
		{FENICS PositionValue} as decimal(24,8),
		{Current MV Variance} as decimal(25,8),
		{RV dayPnlUsd} as decimal(38,6),
		{FENICS MV Change} as decimal(25,8),
		{PNL Variance} as decimal(38,6)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(GetDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		FENICS_PositionValue as integer,
		SubDistrict1Description as string,
		Current_MV_Variance as integer,
		FENICS_ForwardRate as integer,
		RV_Mkt_Value as integer,
		ExternalSystem as string,
		SourceSystemName as string,
		RV_DayPnlUsd as integer,
		Load_Date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		EffDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		RV_holdingCurrency as string,
		Imagine_TradeDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		HoldID as string,
		FENICS_MV_Change as integer,
		RV_account as string,
		Quantity_Variance as integer,
		ReconStatus as string,
		Imagine_External_Trade_ID as string,
		FENICS_CtrCcy as string,
		FENICS_Calc_PositionValue_CcyAmt as integer,
		RV_Strike as integer,
		FENICS_ExpiryDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DistrictDescription as string,
		FENICS_TradeDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		FENICS_Book as string,
		RV_quantity as integer,
		RV_Put_Call as string,
		RV_Expiry as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		FENICS_PositionValue_Prior as integer,
		Mark_Variance as integer,
		PNL_Variance as integer,
		CalypsoId as string,
		DivisionDescription as string,
		FENICS_CcyAmt as integer,
		CompanyAU as string,
		FENICS_ProductType as string,
		FENICS_StrikeRate as integer,
		RV_CurrMark as integer,
		SystemRecord as string,
		FENICS_TicketNo as string,
		FENICS_Au as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		FENICS_PositionValue = {FENICS PositionValue},
		SubDistrict1Description,
		Current_MV_Variance = {Current MV Variance},
		FENICS_ForwardRate = {FENICS ForwardRate},
		RV_Mkt_Value = {RV Mkt Value},
		ExternalSystem,
		SourceSystemName,
		RV_DayPnlUsd = {RV dayPnlUsd},
		Load_Date = GetDate,
		EffDate,
		RV_holdingCurrency = {RV holdingCurrency},
		Imagine_TradeDate = {Imagine TradeDate},
		HoldID,
		FENICS_MV_Change = {FENICS MV Change},
		RV_account = {RV account},
		Quantity_Variance = {Quantity Variance},
		ReconStatus,
		Imagine_External_Trade_ID = {Imagine External_Trade_ID},
		FENICS_CtrCcy = {FENICS CtrCcy},
		FENICS_Calc_PositionValue_CcyAmt = {FENICS Calc: PositionValue / CcyAmt},
		RV_Strike = {RV Strike},
		FENICS_ExpiryDate = {FENICS ExpiryDate},
		DistrictDescription,
		FENICS_TradeDate = {FENICS TradeDate},
		FENICS_Book = {FENICS Book},
		RV_quantity = {RV quantity},
		RV_Put_Call = {RV Put Call},
		RV_Expiry = {RV Expiry},
		FENICS_PositionValue_Prior = {FENICS PositionValue (Prior)},
		Mark_Variance = {Mark Variance},
		PNL_Variance = {PNL Variance},
		CalypsoId,
		DivisionDescription,
		FENICS_CcyAmt = {FENICS CcyAmt},
		CompanyAU,
		FENICS_ProductType = {FENICS ProductType},
		FENICS_StrikeRate = {FENICS StrikeRate},
		RV_CurrMark = {RV CurrMark},
		SystemRecord,
		FENICS_TicketNo = {FENICS TicketNo},
		FENICS_Au = {FENICS Au}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
